meta.title: 为什么你拍的照片眼神总是呆板无神？
meta.title_en: Why Are the Eyes in Your Photos Always Dull and Lifeless?

scenes.title_cn: 开场：这是不是你拍照——眼神呆滞不知…
scenes.title_en: Opening: is this you shooting—glassy eyes,…
sentences: 这是不是你拍照眼神呆滞不知道看哪里，感情尴尬。
Is this you—glassy eyes, unsure where to look, awkward?
glassy eyes（眼神呆滞）
眼睛是心灵的窗户，打开这双窗户就能让照片升华。
Eyes are the window to the soul—open it and the photo transcends.
window to the soul（心灵窗户）
paraphrase: window to the soul（心灵窗户
window to the soul（心灵窗户
scenes.speak: Is this you—glassy eyes, unsure where to look, awkward? Eyes are the window to the soul—open it and the photo transcends.

scenes.title_cn: 眼神的重要性：一个有故事的眼神是人像…
scenes.title_en: Why eyes matter: a storytelling gaze is th…
scenes.context: 形神兼备才是优秀人像。
sentences: 一个有故事的眼神，是人像摄影里画龙点睛之笔。
A storytelling gaze is the finishing stroke of portraiture.
the finishing stroke（点睛之笔）
优秀的人像作品肯定要做到形神兼备。
Great portraits capture both form and spirit.
form and spirit（形神兼备）
好看的皮囊千篇一律，有趣的灵魂万里挑一。
Pretty shells are common; interesting souls are one in a thousand.
one in a thousand（万里挑一）
paraphrase: one in a thousand（万里挑一
one in a thousand（万里挑一
scenes.speak: A storytelling gaze is the finishing stroke of portraiture. Great portraits capture both form and spirit. Pretty shells are common; interesting souls are one in a thousand.

scenes.title_cn: 套近乎：好看的皮囊可以通过修图、整容…
scenes.title_en: Break the ice: a pretty face can be edited…
scenes.context: 套近乎让真实情绪流露。
sentences: 好看的皮囊可以通过修图整容做到，但是一个眼神你再也修不出来。
A pretty face can be edited, but a gaze can never be retouched.
can't retouch a gaze（眼神修不出来）
在朋友面前会比较舒服，能随意地展示自己的情绪和性格。
With friends you feel comfortable and freely show emotion and character.
comfortable with friends（朋友面前舒服）
跟模特做朋友做交流，真实情绪流露，眼神也会越来越有戏。
Befriend your model, real emotion flows, and the eyes grow expressive.
eyes grow expressive（眼神有戏）
paraphrase: can't retouch a gaze（眼神修不出来）
can't retouch a gaze（眼神修不出来）
scenes.speak: A pretty face can be edited, but a gaze can never be retouched. With friends you feel comfortable and freely show emotion and character. Befriend your model, real emotion flows, and the eyes grow expressive.

scenes.title_cn: 剧本引导：为什么好的演员眼睛都非常有…
scenes.title_en: Direct with a script: why do great actors …
scenes.context: 定剧本让模特进入角色。
sentences: 为什么好的演员眼睛都非常有神很有故事？因为人家专业靠这个吃饭。
Why do great actors have vivid, story-filled eyes? It's their profession.
their profession（专业吃饭）
当模特进入了这个角色状态，眼神也会随之变得有内容起来。
When the model enters the character state, the gaze gains content.
enter the character（进入角色）
给他一个故事一个剧本，让模特进入特定的环境状态再进行抓拍。
Give the model a story and environment, then capture candidly.
capture candidly（进行抓拍）
scenes.speak: Why do great actors have vivid, story-filled eyes? It's their profession. When the model enters the character state, the gaze gains content. Give the model a story and environment, then capture candidly.

scenes.title_cn: 呆板眼神的根源：像这种呆板的眼神，通…
scenes.title_en: Root of dull eyes: dull eyes usually mean …
scenes.context: 呆板来自没沟通好故事。
sentences: 呆板的眼神通常是没跟模特沟通好这个情绪、这个故事，他有点紧张。
Dull eyes usually mean the emotion or story wasn't communicated—the model is nervous.
uncommunicated story（没沟通好故事）
抽烟就不看镜头，眼神往旁边一飘，这个眼神同样有力同样有故事。
Smoking means looking away—the gaze drifts aside, equally powerful and storied.
looking away（不看镜头）
要学会找这个角度。
Learn to find that angle.
find the angle（找角度）
scenes.speak: Dull eyes usually mean the emotion or story wasn't communicated—the model is nervous. Smoking means looking away—the gaze drifts aside, equally powerful and storied. Learn to find that angle.

scenes.title_cn: 眼神空洞的对比：任何一个有故事的眼神…
scenes.context: 无剧本拍摄导致眼神空洞。
sentences: 他也不知道自己要拍什么，并没有剧情，所以造成呆板。
They don't know what to shoot and there's no story, so the gaze dulls.
no story（没有剧情）
这是摄影师的问题，没有做到很好的引导。
That dullness is the photographer's failure to direct.
photographer's failure（摄影师的问题）
引导一个故事让模特进入特定的环境，让他思考一下，就有眼神了。
Direct a story, put the model in a setting, let them think—and the gaze appears.
let them think（让他思考）
scenes.speak: They don't know what to shoot and there's no story, so the gaze dulls. That dullness is the photographer's failure to direct. Direct a story, put the model in a setting, let them think—and the gaze appears.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：一个眼神的引导特别重要。
scenes.title_en: Summary: directing the gaze matters enormo…
sentences: 所以一个眼神的引导特别重要。
So directing the gaze matters enormously.
directing the gaze（眼神引导）
scenes.speak: So directing the gaze matters enormously.

practice: A storytelling gaze is the finishing stroke.
Warm up the model to let real emotion flow.
Give the model a story to know what to express.
Smoking means looking away; keep the gaze natural.
Dull eyes mean no story was communicated.
pitfalls: Tell the model to look and snap.
Give a story so the model knows what to express.
Direct emotion—eyes can't be fixed in post.
Capture the inner mood and expression too.
形神兼备才是优秀人像。
Befriend the model so they open up.
套近乎让真实情绪流露。
Force the model to face the lens.
Let natural actions guide the gaze, like smoking looking away.
按常理引导眼神才有力。
shifts: 用 storytelling gaze（有故事的眼神）、window to the soul（心灵窗户）、the finishing stroke（点睛之笔）
用 break the ice（套近乎）、set a script（定剧本）、capture candidly（抓拍）
用 empty gaze（眼神空洞）、uncommunicated story（没沟通好故事）、photographer's failure（摄影师问题）
